listen_address.description: IP address the LysKOM server binds to. Use 0.0.0.0 to listen on all interfaces.

port.description: TCP port number for LysKOM client connections (standard: 4343).

db_dir.description: Absolute path to the directory containing the LysKOM database files.

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections allowed.

max_rooms_per_user.description: Maximum number of conference rooms a single user may create.

max_posts_per_day.description: Maximum number of messages a user may post per day.

allow_anonymous.description: Allow anonymous (unregistered) users to connect and read public conferences.

use_tls.description: Enable TLS encryption for client connections.

tls_cert.description: Path to the TLS certificate file (PEM format). Required if use_tls is true.

tls_key.description: Path to the TLS private key file (PEM format). Required if use_tls is true.

log_level.description: Verbosity level for server logging (debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency).

log_file.description: Path to the server log file. Use 'stdout' to log to standard output.

admins.description: List of user IDs or usernames with administrative privileges.

items.description: User ID or username of an administrator.

blocked_hosts.description: List of IP addresses or hostnames to block from connecting to the server.

items.description: IP address or hostname to deny access.

lang_default.description: Default language code (ISO 639-1) for new users and system messages.

locale_default.description: Default locale for date/time formatting and collation (e.g., 'en_US.UTF-8').

max_text_size.description: Maximum length (in characters) allowed for a single post or text.

auto_backup.description: Enable automatic database backups after writes.

backup_dir.description: Directory where automatic backups are stored.

backup_interval.description: Minimum time (in seconds) between automatic backups.

smtp_servers.description: List of SMTP servers (host or host:port) for sending email notifications.

items.description: SMTP server address (optionally with port, e.g., 'smtp.example.com:587').

email_notifications.description: Enable or disable email notifications for new messages, mentions, etc.

sender_email.description: Email address used as the sender for system-generated emails.

dns_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) for DNS lookups during connection handling.

max_dns_lookups.description: Maximum number of DNS lookups per connection attempt.

rate_limit_registrations.description: Enable rate limiting on new user registrations.

max_registrations_per_ip_per_hour.description: Maximum new registrations allowed per IP address per hour.
